route.conditions: WHO charges no author fees. Research, systematic reviews and policy/practice articles normally have 3000-word limits; there is no paid excess-length route stated. Abstract translation is free. Supplementary material for accepted work must be placed in a DOI-issuing repository; use a free suitable repository. Authors obtain permissions for copyrighted reuse. Apply current affiliation, review-search recency and preprint restrictions.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None for the stated journal route. DOI-repository choice and any third-party reuse permissions can create external costs; free suitable alternatives are needed.

fee_evidence.note: Sections 1.1 and 2.5 exclude all author fees; section 2.3 makes abstract translation free. Article limits and DOI-repository requirements are stated on the same full page.

patches.audit_note: Independent fee audit retained verified_free. Read the complete current WHO contributor policy: its blanket no-author-fees statement covers the ordinary submission/publication route, and the policy lists no compulsory membership, page or language-service payment. Manuscript and repository requirements are conditions, not a selective waiver.

route.conditions: Diamond open access without author/researcher charges or selective fee waiver. English, Portuguese and Spanish manuscripts are accepted. Follow article-specific length and table/reference limits in the full author instructions; no paid excess-page option is stated. Authors obtain permissions for copyrighted reuse and meet data-availability requirements. Regional public-health relevance remains essential.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None stated under the blanket no-researcher-fees policy; no compulsory membership, page charge or editing purchase was found in the full guidance.

fee_evidence.note: Full official page read with urllib despite browser 403: publication costs authors nothing and the diamond model has no fees for researchers or readers.

Complete current official instructions read with urllib: identifies a free open-access journal, specifies manuscript limits and permissions duties, and states no compulsory author payment or membership.

patches.audit_note: Promoted from needs_verification to verified_free. route.conditions: No author fees for ordinary articles, including submission, pages and corrections. route.other_mandatory_costs: None for standard individual-article submission/publication. Supplement-organizer costs are excluded.

The official 2024 report independently excludes submission, page, correction and other author fees; dated corroboration.

patches.audit_note: Retained verified_free using a stronger current source: the EID Advantage page was updated 8 October 2026 and explicitly excludes submission, page, correction and other author fees. route.conditions: Ordinary journal articles use a diamond route free to authors and readers under ECDC funding. route.other_mandatory_costs: None for the ordinary author route under the publisher blanket free-to-authors statement; special supplement-organizer terms not audited.

fee_evidence.note: Current full publisher page identifies the Eurosurveillance Editorial Office and describes its journal specifically as diamond open access free of charge to readers and authors.
Official 2025 publisher notice says all Eurosurveillance content is open access free to readers and authors, with ECDC procuring editorial/copyediting support.

patches.audit_note: Promoted from needs_verification to verified_free on current journal-specific publisher evidence. route.other_mandatory_costs: No page or colour charges and no mandatory membership stated. Submission fee remains unknown; optional OA is paid unless covered.

patches.audit_note: Retained needs_verification. Independently read complete OUP author guidance and its Why Publish page. The standard licence, page and colour charges are expressly zero, but no blanket no-author-fees statement or journal-specific no-submission-fee policy was located. The ScholarOne destination was blocked. No mandatory membership was stated; membership benefits elsewhere are not an author requirement.

route.conditions: Select standard subscription publication and keep original, review or design articles within five printed pages, counting abstract, tables, figures and references. Above five pages the mandatory charge is GBP 80 or USD 100 per excess page excluding VAT. Word limits alone do not establish free eligibility: reviews may allow 6000 words yet exceed five printed pages. Optional OA and requested print colour cost extra. Sponsored supplements are excluded.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None within the five-printed-page route without optional print colour/OA. Mandatory excess-page charges apply beyond five pages; supplement authors/sponsors fund supplement costs.

fee_evidence.note: Complete current journal instructions state no submission/publication fees, then impose GBP 80/USD 100 per printed page above five for original/review/design articles, excluding VAT; optional OA, requested print colour and supplements have separate costs.

patches.audit_note: Retained verified_free only for the explicitly bounded standard route. route.conditions: Standard subscription publication is free to submit and publish. Online colour is free; requested print colour and optional OA incur separate charges. route.other_mandatory_costs: None for standard publication without optional print colour or OA. Third-party material permissions are the authors responsibility.

fee_evidence.note: Current official indexed policy explicitly excludes submitting and publishing fees and distinguishes optional print-colour/OA costs. Direct page fetch timed out; indexed content was available.

patches.audit_note: Retained verified_free. route.conditions: Standard subscription route has no submission or publication fees. Online colour is free; requested print colour and optional OA cost extra. route.other_mandatory_costs: None for standard publication without optional print colour or OA; no compulsory society membership stated.

fee_evidence.note: Full current journal policy explicitly excludes submission/publication fees and distinguishes optional print-colour/OA costs; article and plain-language-summary requirements are stated on the same page.

route.other_mandatory_costs: Publication APC unless qualifying full coverage/waiver applies. No page or colour charges; membership optional. Submission fee unknown.

fee_evidence.note: Full current journal policy identifies fully OA publication, compulsory APCs, EUR 2956 regular/EUR 1408 short-report charges, conditional institutional coverage/waivers, 20% member discount and no page/colour fees; no explicit no-submission-fee statement.

Quoted APC figures are current-policy observations, not permanent prices.

route.conditions: English-language submissions. fee_evidence.note: Full official policy expressly excludes article/submission processing charges and author publishing fees; separately lists optional reader print-subscription prices.

route.other_mandatory_costs: None for the stated journal route, including its provided translations; no compulsory author membership stated.

route.other_mandatory_costs: None for standard submission, processing and publication; no compulsory membership or editing service stated.

route.other_mandatory_costs: None for standard articles; no compulsory membership stated. Optional reprints, advertisements and supplement sponsorship are separate.

patches.audit_note: Promoted from needs_verification to verified_free. Independently read current official General Information, including its blanket no-fees-or-charges-associated-with-publishing policy, and the submission instructions reviewed 24 July 2026. Taken together this is an ordinary author route with no journal author charge, not merely free reader access. Requiring a separately named submission-fee sentence would overstate uncertainty; no contradictory payment, membership or excess-page obligation appears.

notes: Independently audited all 14 discovery/diamond candidates. Final route eligibility: 12 verified_free for the stated route, one needs_verification (OUP Journal of Public Health submission cost) and one conditional (European Journal of Public Health paid OA). Every patch supplies the entire replacement route and a record-specific audit note.

Promoted PAHO, Eurosurveillance and Preventing Chronic Disease using unequivocal current official blanket author-cost policies. Blanket no-author-fees/free-for-authors evidence covers ordinary submission and publication without artificially requiring those two words in separate sentences. Free reader access or an isolated no-APC claim alone was not treated as sufficient.

PAHO complete official About/Instructions pages were accessible with ordinary Python urllib despite browser 403. Eurosurveillance author/editorial pages remained blocked; current journal-specific ECDC publisher pages explicitly establish the free author route, while exact current article-length and supplement-organizer requirements remain for manuscript preparation. Public Health Reports direct HTML fetch timed out/was blocked, but its official hosted full PDF and current indexed policy agreed.

Scandinavian Journal of Public Health is verified_free only within five printed pages counting abstract/tables/figures/references. Above that ceiling, original/review/design papers incur GBP 80 or USD 100 per excess page excluding VAT. Word limits do not override the printed-page charge.

European Journal of Public Health currently requires paid OA; its EUR 2956 regular/EUR 1408 short-report prices and 20% optional member discount were observed in current official guidance. Institutional coverage and waivers are conditional; membership is not free publication. OUP Journal of Public Health still offers a zero-charge standard licence, page and colour route, but absent explicit submission-fee evidence it remains needs_verification.

Excluded lead independently reconfirmed: current Thai Journal of Public Health submissions policy https://he02.tci-thaijo.org/index.php/jph/about/submissions (updated 28 October 2026) requires USD 220 after acceptance, effective 1 June 2026. It overrides the old Mahidol no-fee page and is not an unconditional free route.

No compulsory society-membership or mandatory paid editing prerequisite was found for any of the 12 verified ordinary routes. Optional OA, requested print colour, reader subscriptions, reprints/ads, third-party permissions and supplement-organizer funding are distinguished where applicable. Format/recency/language/region conditions remain substantive; verified author cost is not acceptance or human scientific approval.

Official policies were accessed live on 16 November 2026. Fees and limits can change; recheck before a real submission. No venue was contacted, research submitted, software installed or remote state changed.
